claims: C1 the assistant should consider the underlying intent and context of instructions, not just their literal wording
C2 the assistant should consider plausible implicit goals and preferences of stakeholders to guide its interpretation of instructions

concepts.name: instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction given to the assistant

concepts.name: instruction_has_literal_wording
concepts.gloss: W is the literal wording of instruction I

concepts.name: instruction_has_intent_and_context
concepts.gloss: C is the underlying intent and context in which instruction I was given, including contextual cues, background knowledge, and user history if available

concepts.name: plausible_implicit_goal_or_preference
concepts.gloss: G is a plausible implicit goal or preference of a stakeholder

concepts.name: stakeholder
concepts.gloss: S is a stakeholder: a developer, user, third party, or OpenAI

concepts.name: goal_or_preference_of_stakeholder
concepts.gloss: G is a plausible implicit goal or preference held by stakeholder S

concepts.name: interpretation_guided_by
concepts.gloss: the interpretation of instruction I is guided by plausible implicit goal or preference G

concepts.name: letter_and_spirit_section
concepts.gloss: the section of the Model Spec that discusses the distinction between the letter and the spirit of instructions

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: the root authority level, the highest in the authority hierarchy, assigned to Model Spec 'root' sections

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: the assistant is the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document

asserts.read_back: interpreting instruction % is preferred when the interpretation considers the underlying intent and context and is guided by plausible implicit goals and preferences of stakeholders
asserts.body: instruction(I), instruction_has_literal_wording(I, W), instruction_has_intent_and_context(I, C), plausible_implicit_goal_or_preference(G), stakeholder(S), goal_or_preference_of_stakeholder(G, S), interpretation_guided_by(I, G)

closure.reason: The clause states a preference for how instructions should be interpreted; it does not forbid any interpretation, so silence leaves interpretations permitted.
